steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Scrub the squash under warm water and pat dry.
Tightly wrap the squash with two layers of aluminum foil. Bake for about 1 hour, until a knife can easily pierce through the aluminum foil, into the squash.
Transfer the squash to a plate or tray. Chill at room temperature until the squash is cool enough to be handled with bare hands.
Carefully unwrap the foil. Remove the squash stem and slice into smaller chunks that fit in a countertop blender. The squash skin and seeds can be blended in the soup, no need to peel or deseed it.
Add the warm squash to a large countertop blender. Add the vegetable stock, cottage cheese, sugar and a big pinch of salt.

Place the lid on the blender and remove the small plug in the center (this will allow the steam to escape as the soup is blended). Cover the opening with a kitchen towel and carefully blend until smooth. Taste and season with more sugar or salt, as needed.
